state.objective: Define the minimum evidence and likely resolution path for 104 legacy COA accounts currently held separately, so they can be migrated, merged, reclassified or retained safely.
state.organization: One PT Perorangan; all named units are sites, not separate legal entities. Centralized HO Finance. No unit-to-unit legal balances. No foreign currency, overdraft or pledged deposits.
state.approved_core: Jev approved the 121-account core as a reasonable production baseline with confidence 1.0. Jev rejected making all 225 permanent and rejected implementing the 142 conditional target without evidence, both with confidence 1.0.

replacement_oe.composition: 36 Reserve Replacement OE asset/contra-like accounts and 36 matching Replacement OE expense accounts, split by rack, display, table, mannequin, hanger and store-equipment item names.

principal.composition: 14 Hutang Lain-lain Principal accounts named by HO/unit plus one PJP Jatuh Tempo - Principal. All units are sites of the same PT.

land_right_and_rent.composition: HGB/land-right cost, accumulated amortization, land-right expense, land rent, store/warehouse building rent and staff-house/mess rent.

preopening.composition: Pre Opening asset, accumulated amortization and pre-opening amortization expense.

purchase_cogs.composition: Harga Pokok Pembelian and Potongan Pembelian.

singletons.composition: Disposed Inventory; Contract in Progress/CIP; Giro Keluar; Inventory Damage Expense; mixed Pendapatan (Biaya) Lain-Lain; Current Tax Income/Expense PPh 25.

state.existing_dimensions: site_id, asset_id, asset_class_id, facility_id, contract_id, supplier/party_id, bank_account_id, inventory_class, document_id and tax code are available or planned.
state.principle: A legacy name alone is not evidence. Decisions should be supported by transaction history, balances, contracts, registers, schedules, tax filings and reconciliation to GL.

replacement_oe_minimum.instructions: What is the minimum decisive evidence for the 72 Replacement OE accounts?

criteria.register_policy_activity: Asset/OE register by item and site, capitalization/replacement policy, useful lives, opening balances and transaction history tied to disposal/replacement documents.
criteria.none: They can all be deleted without checking balances.

replacement_oe_likely.instructions: If item identity is fully held in an asset/OE register and accounting policy is uniform, what is the likely resolution?

criteria.compress: Map cost/contra balances to the appropriate Operating Equipment asset/allowance accounts and replacement expense to a small number of expense natures; retain item/site in subledger dimensions.

replacement_oe_obligation.instructions: What must be established before treating Reserve Replacement OE as a liability or contra account?

criteria.present_obligation: A present legal/constructive obligation, measurement basis, approval policy and roll-forward; an internal earmark alone is insufficient.
criteria.name: The word Reserve in the account name is sufficient.
criteria.budget: A budget automatically creates a liability.

principal_minimum.instructions: What evidence is required for the 15 Principal accounts?

criteria.counterparty_agreement_aging: Counterparty identity, owner/related-party status, contracts or funding documents, opening balances, transaction ledger, maturity/current-noncurrent terms and settlement history.
criteria.site_names: Unit names in account titles are sufficient.

principal_likely.instructions: If the 14 unit-named Principal accounts are the same counterparty/funding nature and units are only sites, what is the likely resolution?

criteria.one_related_balance: Use the proper related-party/owner payable or equity account, with site/document dimensions only if analytically needed.
criteria.keep14: Retain one GL account per unit.
criteria.intercompany: Treat units as separate intercompany counterparties.

principal_equity_gate.instructions: What distinguishes a Principal balance that should be liability versus owner equity/drawings?

criteria.rights_terms: Repayment obligation, contractual terms, subordination, owner authorization, and legal/tax substance.
criteria.debit_credit: Credit balance alone proves it is equity.
criteria.name: The word Principal determines classification.

hgb_minimum.instructions: What evidence is required for HGB/land-right accounts?

criteria.legal_policy_schedule: Land certificate/right contract, acquisition terms, right period/renewal, accounting policy, useful life/amortization schedule, tax treatment and GL roll-forward.
criteria.name: Account names alone.
criteria.rent_invoice: One rent invoice is sufficient for every HGB balance.

rent_minimum.instructions: What evidence is required for land, store/warehouse and staff-house rent accounts?

criteria.contracts_schedules_use: Contracts, payment schedules, lease term/options, asset use, site/facility mapping, tax and applicable lease-accounting assessment.
criteria.gl: A GL balance with no contract.

preopening_minimum.instructions: What evidence is required for the three pre-opening accounts?

criteria.cost_detail_dates_policy: Detailed cost composition, store opening dates, recognition policy, remaining balances, amortization schedule and impairment/recoverability review.
criteria.name: Name alone proves an asset.

cip_minimum.instructions: What evidence is required for CIP?

criteria.project_cost_progress: Project list, approved budgets, invoices, directly attributable costs, physical progress, placed-in-service dates and reconciliation to fixed-asset additions.

giro_keluar_minimum.instructions: What evidence decides whether Giro Keluar can merge with Outstanding Giro?

criteria.instrument_register: Cheque/giro register, issuance and clearing/cancellation lifecycle, bank statement reconciliation, aging and posting examples for both accounts.

purchase_cogs_minimum.instructions: What evidence is needed for Harga Pokok Pembelian and Potongan Pembelian?

criteria.inventory_method_postings: Perpetual/periodic inventory policy, purchase/receipt/invoice/return/discount posting rules, transaction samples and reconciliation to inventory and COGS.

inventory_disposal_damage.instructions: What evidence is required for Disposed Inventory and Inventory Damage Expense?

criteria.writeoff_documents: Approved write-off/disposal documents, quantity/value movement, recovery proceeds, reason codes, insurance claims and reconciliation to inventory allowance/COGS.
criteria.count: Stock-count sheet with no accounting trace.

mixed_other_minimum.instructions: How should mixed Pendapatan (Biaya) Lain-Lain be resolved?

criteria.transaction_split: Export transaction-level ledger with source documents and classify income and expense separately; do not retain a mixed-sign account merely for convenience.
criteria.keep_mixed: Keep one permanent mixed income/expense account.

pph25_minimum.instructions: What evidence is required for Current Tax Income/Expense PPh 25?

criteria.returns_payments_recon: SPT/tax returns, installment payments, current-tax computation, tax payable/prepaid reconciliation and transaction history.
criteria.name: Name alone.

evidence_period.instructions: What transaction-history period is normally sufficient to assess recurring use and mapping?

criteria.two_years_plus_opening: At least the current and prior fiscal year plus opening balance and all still-open items; extend for long-lived assets/contracts.

zero_balance_accounts.instructions: Can a zero-balance hold account be retired solely because its closing balance is zero?

criteria.activity_check: Only after checking historical/current activity, open documents, integrations and whether future posting rules still reference it.
criteria.yes: Yes, zero balance alone is sufficient.
criteria.never: A zero-balance account can never be retired.

evidence_package.instructions: What is the most efficient evidence package to request from the client?

criteria.seven_exports: GL transaction export and opening balance; asset/OE register; loan/owner funding schedule and agreements; lease/HGB contracts and schedules; inventory write-off/movement report; bank giro register/reconciliation; tax returns/reconciliation and accounting policies.
criteria.interviews: Only verbal interviews without reconciled data.

resolution_order.instructions: In what order should the hold groups be resolved?

criteria.volume_risk: Replacement OE first for volume, Principal second for classification/related-party risk, then leases/HGB/pre-opening/CIP, then giro/purchase/inventory/tax singletons.

can_resolve.instructions: Can the 104 held accounts be resolved without redesigning the approved 121-account core?

criteria.yes_evidence: Yes; obtain the evidence package, reconcile balances and map each account to core, a justified new account, or retirement.
